thread:
anna_pm: Heads-up: KeyLoom reached out to pilot an integrated marketplace listing that bundles their HSM-backed KMS with our SSO/SCIM flow. Need a quick ops + announcement plan.

james_sales: Nice. They propose a joint announcement in early July. Can we make that date? :calendar:

mira_eng: Early July is doable if we parallelize. KMS BYOK tests across AWS and GCP need 5 working days, SAML end-to-end verification 2 days, SCIM sync smoke 1 day.

oliver_security: We'll require KeyLoom's FIPS cert and PKCS#11 compatibility statement before any public marketing. Also prepping a short threat-model addendum for Private customers. Legal will want that for signoff.

partner_ops: On the KeyLoom side we can slide the public date by up to 7 days if needed, but they need a staging marketplace tile published to partners the same day as the announcement.

anna_pm: Proposed plan: 1) Partner provides certs by Tue AM, 2) Run KMS BYOK tests (5d) + in-parallel SAML/SCIM smoke (3d combined), 3) HSM attestation + risk doc parallel (3d). Can we compress the engineering work?

mira_eng: We can compress KMS testing to 3 full days if we allocate two engineers and run tests in parallel across clouds. HSM rotation test requires a small infra change (PKCS#11 shim) ~2 eng days.

oliver_security: I'll draft the risk doc and coordinate legal. Need KeyLoom to deliver the vendor attestation and test vectors by EOD Tuesday.

james_sales: I'll confirm the timeline with KeyLoom and Legal. They prefer a 48-hour embargo window.

marketing_lead: We'll prepare draft marketplace copy and a preview asset for partners. Who should we coordinate with on the product screenshot?

anna_pm: Marketing + Product for tile assets. Eng-ops to create a staging tile account with marketplace scope.

devops_bot: Ticket INF-9833 created: marketplace/staging/tile-keyloom assigned to eng-ops. ETA 48h.

mira_eng: One more: routing policy. When customer selects KeyLoom KMS, route crypto ops to the dedicated crypto pool in us-west1 to meet latency SLOs. Add a policy rule to routing-config.

partner_ops: KeyLoom asked for a graceful fallback UX if HSM handshake fails. They want the error to suggest "switch to hosted KMS" with a clear next step and an incident log entry.

oliver_security: Implement auto-fallback to hosted KMS with incident tag #keyloom-kms-fallback and notify oncall for any handshake 5xx. Ensure full audit trail is recorded.

anna_pm: Owners recap: Partner to provide certs and test vectors (partner_ops); infra routing + PKCS#11 shim + fallback (mira_eng + eng-ops); HSM attestation and risk/legal coordination (oliver_security); marketplace tile + copy + preview (marketing_lead + james_sales). Targets: staging preview 2026-07-01, announce 2026-07-08 with 48h embargo.

james_sales: I'll lock dates with KeyLoom today and loop Legal.

partner_ops: Confirmed on our side. We'll deliver certs Tue AM and join smoke tests Wed.

anna_pm: Great. If blockers appear, tag me and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
